svg.title: Centralized Amazon Bedrock Guardrails — reference implementation
svg.text: Centralized Amazon Bedrock Guardrails — what this reference implementation builds
Layers 1, 3 and 4 are deployed or scripted here. Layer 2 (SCP) is optional and described in the blog post only — it is not shipped as code.
Workload Account(s) in the target OU
Delivery and evidence (all in this repository)

g.text: type BEDROCK_POLICY, attached to the OU
auto-applies to every invoke in the OU
Not in this repository — example shown
in the blog; author + review your own

svg.text: Independent replica of the guardrail stack per target account / region — not a shared guardrail

g.text: per account + region · evaluates every invoke
Evaluates every applicable guardrail on the same call: org-enforced, account-enforced and request-supplied.
Assessments are unioned; any BLOCKED finding sets amazon-bedrock-guardrailAction = INTERVENED

svg.text: Any principal with bedrock:InvokeModel — the benchmark and verify scripts play this role here

g.text: p99 latency budget on benign prompts
Known-bad prompt → INTERVENED, and the BLOCKED
assessment is attributed to the deployed guardrail
— off by default, enable on the trail

text.style: font-family: 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size:11.5px

svg.text: results/ is chmod 0700 / files 0600 (may contain prompts and PII detections) — treat as sensitive
Optional control, described in the blog — not shipped
Not depicted because not built: IAM Identity Center, AWS Config, CodePipeline.
